author: Spoookeh
body:
Age: 16

Timezone: BST / GMT

Do you have Teamspeak?: Yes

Do you have Discord?: Yes 

Do you have access to a recording software?: Yes, Action and OBS



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?: Not on any other servers, but I was previously a moderator on avicus for 7 months between July 2016 and January 2017.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?: My argumentative side. I have my opinions and will stick by them; if others disagree and wish to have a 'debate' about it I'll stick up for myself. In other words I'm quite stubborn. 


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? In short they need to have focus on the job, confidence in both themselves and their team, passion for what they do but most importantly in this situation transparency with the community. In some ways I would consider myself a leader, I like the organisation that goes on behind the scenes and consider myself a competent person to lead a group. 


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?: I feel like I am mature for my age, in terms of organising groups of people and specific events. Another factor that would put me ahead of other applicants is that I've already had 7 months of previous experience and understand the policies/guidelines. 


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?: Patience is probably the most important skill; they/we can be very toxic towards the staff team especially on the forums, and you must be able to deal with them without looking especially toxic yourself. Transparency earns the trust of the community too, so there must be constant updates, whether it's on discord or the forums, of what's happening throughout the server. Yes I do believe I have these skills because I'm more than aware of what's required when interacting with the community. 


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?: Understanding of the rules, confidence in your own decisions and patience to make the right decision. 



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? Let a senior know so they can deal with it in terms of warnings and demotions. I'd also personally talk to them to make sure they understand that they're being lazy and the consequences of it.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? Ask for them to stop and refer them to the rules of the channel which state "No Racism or Harassment", so it isn't actually allowed. Sure I'd have a laugh with them because I agree to some extent but if it's going beyond the rules then punishments would have to be issued, no matter what players they are. 



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Before going to a senior I'd pm the teammate and ask them to delete it ASAP. If they refuse and have the intent of properly leaking I'd have to go to a senior. But of course I wouldn't tell straight away because a teammate is a friend and some bias would be involved, it's natural. 



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?: Ask them to stop or tone it down. If they refuse I could only go to an admin to sort it out.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?: I want to help avicus progress forwards again, instead of just messing round in-game and on the forums. I also see some things happening inside the staff team that I'd like to help avoid. 


What does Avicus mean to you?: Well I've been playing on here since MCZone, for 4-5+ years. I've spent many hours playing and talking with the community so of course it means a lot to me. The people I've met and experiences I've had will stay in my memory for many years to come. 


Anything specific the staff team could do better?: T R A N S P A R E N C Y. Let the community know what you're doing. 


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?: Didn't seem to be getting anywhere talking to seniors to get my mod rank back so here I am applying again.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?: Thanks for reading, hopefully I'll be returning to the team soon.
